outcome: adverse pregnancy outcomes (low birth weight <2.5 kg, premature delivery, neonatal death, fetal distress, fetal death)
cohort: Pregnant women who presented to a national trauma center between 2015 and 2021.
finding: Trauma during pregnancy is associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes, with hypertension, diabetes mellitus, placental abruption, a history of previous C-section, and gestational age at the time of injury identified as predictors.
mod_finding: A history of previous C-section was associated with an increased likelihood of adverse pregnancy outcomes.
